note: NO IMAGE URL SUPPLIED. DNS resolution failed for every candidate host in this run (filmheritagefoundation.co.in, whatson.bfi.org.uk, ilcinemaritrovato.it, upload.wikimedia.org all returned ENOTFOUND), so no official press-asset URL could be read and verified, and none is guessed here. Four WebSearches were spent looking. The stills exist on three legitimate press pages and need picking up by hand or by a later run with working DNS: (1) Film Heritage Foundation's own release at https://filmheritagefoundation.co.in/4k-restoration-of-kamal-amrohi-masterpiece-pakeezah-1972/ , (2) the BFI LFF 2026 programme page at https://whatson.bfi.org.uk/lff/Online/article/pakeezah-lff26 , (3) Il Cinema Ritrovato's film page at https://ilcinemaritrovato.it/en/film/pakeezah/ . Wikipedia's infobox poster was deliberately NOT used: it is a fair-use upload, not free-licence, and a 1972 Indian film is still in copyright in India until 2033.
